description: Database = organized data ka ghar, Apps data yahin store karte hain, Excel jaisa, par bahut bada aur fast, Baat karne ki language: SQL.
SQL = Structured Query Language, Database se sawaal poochho, Answer table ki form mein, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server sab SQL bolte hain.
Table = data ka grid, Column = field (name, salary), Row = record (ek employee), Cell = ek value.
INT = whole numbers, VARCHAR(n) = text, DECIMAL(10,2) = paisa, DATE = taareekh, BOOLEAN = true/false.
PRIMARY KEY = unique + NOT NULL, Har row ki pehchaan, Ek table, ek primary key, Usually id column.
CREATE TABLE naam (...), Har column: naam + type, Comma se alag karo, Semicolon se khatam.
INSERT INTO table (cols), VALUES (...), Text 'single quotes' mein, Multiple rows: comma se.
SELECT = kya chahiye, * = saare columns, FROM = kis table se, ; = query khatam.
SELECT col1, col2, Comma se alag, Order aap decide karo, Fast + clean result.
AS = temporary naam, Sirf result mein, Space ho toh quotes mein, Calculation ke saath useful.
DISTINCT = unique values, Duplicates hatao, Multiple columns par combination unique, COUNT(DISTINCT) bhi hota hai.
WHERE = filter, Condition true → row rahegi, Text 'quotes' mein, FROM ke baad aata hai.
= barabar, <> ya != not equal, > < bada/chhota, >= <= barabar bhi.
AND = dono true, OR = koi ek true, NOT = ulta, Mix karo toh ( ) lagao.
IN (list) = koi bhi value match, Multiple OR ka shortcut, NOT IN = list ke bahar, Subquery ke saath bhi chalta hai.
BETWEEN a AND b, Dono ends include, Numbers + dates, NOT BETWEEN bhi hai.
LIKE = pattern search, % = kuch bhi, _ = ek character, 'A%' = A se shuru.
NULL = missing value, NULL ≠ 0 ≠ '', = NULL kaam nahi karta, IS NULL / IS NOT NULL.
ORDER BY col, ASC = chhote se bada (default), DESC = bade se chhota, Multiple: ORDER BY dept, salary DESC.
LIMIT n = pehli n rows, ORDER BY ke saath use karo, SQL Server: SELECT TOP 3, OFFSET = rows skip.
COUNT(*) = saari rows, COUNT(col) = non-NULL, COUNT(DISTINCT col) = unique, Result = ek number.
SUM(col) = total, AVG(col) = average, Sirf numbers, NULL ignore.
MAX(col) = sabse bada, MIN(col) = sabse chhota, Numbers, dates, text, NULL ignore.
GROUP BY = same value ka group, Har group par aggregate, SELECT mein group col + aggregate, Ek group = ek result row.
HAVING = groups ka filter, GROUP BY ke baad, Aggregates ke saath, WHERE rows, HAVING groups.
WHERE → rows, pehle, HAVING → groups, baad mein, WHERE mein aggregate nahi, Dono saath: WHERE → GROUP BY → HAVING.
UPDATE table, SET col = value, WHERE zaroori!, Bina WHERE = saari rows.
DELETE FROM table, WHERE se chuno, Bina WHERE = saari rows gone, Table structure rehta hai.
DELETE = kuch rows (WHERE), TRUNCATE = saari rows, fast, DROP = table hi khatam, DELETE DML, TRUNCATE/DROP DDL.
ALTER TABLE ... ADD col type, DROP COLUMN col, RENAME COLUMN, Structure badlo, data safe.
NOT NULL = khaali nahi, UNIQUE = repeat nahi, DEFAULT = automatic value, CHECK = condition (salary > 0).
FOREIGN KEY = doosri table ka reference, Child → Parent, Galat value block, Relationships banata hai.
Data alag tables mein, Common column = key, JOIN = tables jodo, 4 types: INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL.
INNER JOIN = sirf match, Unmatched dono taraf gayab, Venn diagram ka beech, JOIN = INNER JOIN.
LEFT JOIN = left ki saari rows, No match → NULL, Pura left circle, WHERE right.col IS NULL = jinka match nahi.
RIGHT JOIN = right ki saari rows, No match → NULL, Tables swap = LEFT JOIN, SQLite purane versions mein nahi.
FULL JOIN = dono ki saari rows, Unmatched → NULL, Dono circles poore, MySQL: LEFT UNION RIGHT.
SELF JOIN = table khud se, Do aliases zaroori, Hierarchy ke liye, Employee → Manager.
UNION = rows upar-neeche, UNION duplicates hatata hai, UNION ALL sab rakhta hai, fast, Columns same count + type.
Subquery = query ke andar query, ( ) mein, Andar wali pehle chalti hai, WHERE, FROM, SELECT mein.
CASE WHEN cond THEN val, ELSE default, END se band, New column bana sakte ho.
UPPER / LOWER, LENGTH (SQL Server: LEN), CONCAT(a, b), TRIM = extra spaces hatao.
CURRENT_DATE = aaj, YEAR(date) / EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date), DATEDIFF = farq, Syntax DB ke hisaab se.
1 FROM / JOIN, 2 WHERE, 3 GROUP BY, 4 HAVING, 5 SELECT, 6 ORDER BY, 7 LIMIT.
VIEW = saved query, Virtual table, Data store nahi karta, Security + simplicity.
INDEX = book ka index, Search fast, WHERE/JOIN columns par, Zyada index = slow writes.
Method 1: MAX < MAX subquery, Method 2: ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1, DISTINCT zaroor, Nth: OFFSET N-1.
SELECT · FROM, WHERE · ORDER BY · LIMIT, COUNT · SUM · AVG · GROUP BY · HAVING, JOINs, INSERT · UPDATE · DELETE.
GROUP BY col1, col2, Har unique combination = ek group, SELECT mein dono columns, Order matter nahi karta (result same).
SUM(CASE WHEN ... THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), Ek query, kai metrics, Reports ka favourite, COUNT(CASE WHEN ...) bhi chalta hai.
ROLLUP = subtotals + grand total, Extra row mein NULL, MySQL: WITH ROLLUP, PostgreSQL/SQL Server: ROLLUP(col).
Pivot = rows → columns, Har naya column = ek SUM(CASE), GROUP BY se rows, Excel pivot table jaisa.
Window function = har row + calculation, Keyword: OVER(), Rows merge nahi hoti, Ranking, totals, LAG/LEAD.
AVG() OVER (PARTITION BY dept), Rows rehti hain, Har row ko apne group ka average, Compare karna easy.
ROW_NUMBER() = 1,2,3..., OVER (ORDER BY ...) zaroori, Tie mein bhi unique number, Duplicates hatane mein kaam aata hai.
ROW_NUMBER: 1,2,3,4, RANK: 1,2,2,4 (gap), DENSE_RANK: 1,2,2,3 (no gap), Interview favourite.
PARTITION BY = groups mein todo, Har partition mein numbering 1 se, ORDER BY partition ke andar, GROUP BY jaisa, par rows rehti hain.
Step 1: ROW_NUMBER PARTITION BY dept, Step 2: CTE/subquery, Step 3: WHERE rn = 1, Top N: rn <= N.
SUM() OVER (ORDER BY ...), Har row = ab tak ka total, Cumulative sum, Finance aur sales reports.
ROWS BETWEEN n PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW, Sliding window, Trend smooth karo, 7-day average jaise metrics.
LAG(col) = pichli row, LAG(col, 2) = do row peeche, Pehli row → NULL, Growth: amount - LAG(amount).
LEAD(col) = agli row, Aakhri row → NULL, Next event, next date, LAG ka jodidaar.
NTILE(n) = n barabar buckets, Quartile: NTILE(4), Top 25% nikalna, Customer segmentation.
FIRST_VALUE = window ki pehli value, LAST_VALUE = aakhri, Trap: default frame, ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING.
SUM() OVER () = grand total, salary * 100.0 / total, ROUND(..., 1), Share/contribution report.
DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC), CTE mein daalo, WHERE rnk = N, Ties handle.
WITH naam AS (query), Temporary result, Table ki tarah use, Multiple CTEs: comma se.
WITH RECURSIVE, Anchor + recursive part, UNION ALL, Stop condition zaroori.
Inner query outer column use karti hai, Har row ke liye chalti hai, Powerful par slow, Window function se replace ho sakti hai.
EXISTS = hai ya nahi, Pehla match milte hi stop, IN = list se match, NOT IN + NULL = trap, NOT EXISTS safe.
COALESCE(a, b, c) = pehli non-NULL, NULL ki jagah default, NULLIF(a, b) = barabar toh NULL, x / NULLIF(y, 0) = no divide error.
CAST(x AS type), '123' → 123, 123 → '123', Text sorting: '10' < '9'.
CROSS JOIN = har row x har row, Rows = A x B, ON nahi lagta, Combinations / calendars.
Find: GROUP BY + HAVING COUNT(*) > 1, Number: ROW_NUMBER PARTITION BY email, Keep rn = 1, Delete rn > 1.
BEGIN = shuru, COMMIT = pakka save, ROLLBACK = sab wapas, All or nothing.
A = Atomicity (all or nothing), C = Consistency (rules safe), I = Isolation (no clash), D = Durability (saved forever).
1NF = ek cell, ek value, 2NF = partial dependency hatao, 3NF = transitive dependency hatao, Kam duplicate, kam bugs.
CREATE PROCEDURE, Parameters (IN), CALL proc('IT'), Reusable logic.
Self JOIN: e.manager_id = m.id, WHERE e.salary > m.salary, Aliases zaroori, Classic interview question.
Date → month, GROUP BY month, SUM(amount), ORDER BY month.
Window: ROW_NUMBER · RANK · DENSE_RANK, LAG · LEAD · Running total, CTE · Recursive CTE, EXISTS · Transactions · ACID.
EXPLAIN ANALYZE se execution plan milta hai, type, rows, Extra se bottleneck pehchano, Index ya column selection se plan improve karo, Har query ke liye plan check karna best practice
Partitioning = Badi table ke chote tukde, Partition Pruning se queries fast, Range, List aur Hash types, Purana data drop karna easy
Sharding = data alag servers par baantna, Scale-out ke liye zaroori, Shard Key dhyan se chunni padti hai, Complexity laata hai, jab zaroorat ho tabhi use karo
